headline: Congress powers down for the long weekend with back-to-back pro forma sessions and small business bills still in the hopper.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Friday, October 9, convening at 1:30 p.m. and adjourning just 38 seconds later until Tuesday. No substantive business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly in pro forma session on Friday, October 9, convening at 12:30 p.m. and adjourning two minutes later at 12:32 p.m. No votes or quorum calls were held. The chamber introduced 27 new bills and filed 9 committee reports focused on small business administration improvements.

onTheFloor.title: Clarify and expand authority of the Assistant Secretary for Management of the Department of Veterans Affairs
Require SBA to maintain website for small business concerns relating to onshoring manufacturing capacity
Require SBA to disseminate information on foreign adversary conduct harmful to small businesses
Require quarterly reports on small business investment companies
Require SBA to establish procedures for consistency in disaster loan outreach materials
Direct SBA Veterans Business Development Associate Administrator to ensure reporting compliance
Improve small business loan guaranty program and enhance manufacturer access to affordable capital
Provide interim partial payment to small business contractors requesting equitable adjustment for contract changes
